chapter.verse: Sabbath ni khat, mangbuh lozau teng tawnin Jesu a pai laitak ama' nungzuite in buhvuiite zutkhia uh a, a khut sung uhah nuai-in ne uh hi.
Tu-in Pharisee-te kimkhat in, "Sabbath ni-a hihding phaltheih ahilo na, bang hangin hih na hi uh hiam?" ci uh hi.
Jesu in, "David a kikholhpihte gilkialin a om laitak amah'n bang hih cih thu simkha ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' innpi sungah amah lutin midangte' nek ding phaltheih ahilo, siampite bek' ading ahi, Ompihna anlum la-in ne uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah, "Mihing' Tapa pen Sabbath' tungah ukna nei ahi hi," ci hi.
Sabbath ni a dang khat, vengkhawm inn ah Jesu lutin thu hilhcian a, tua mun ah taklam khut a zaw mi khat om hi.
Laisiamte leh Pharisee-te in Jesu a mawhmat theih nading uh thu muhkhak ding ngimna tawh Sabbath ni-in cina a damsak ding hiam ci-in vil gige uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amau' lunggeelna thei ahih manin khutzaw mipa' kiangah, "Hong pai inla hih takah ding in," ci hi. Mipa zong dingto-in mihonpi' mai-ah dingtang hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in mite' kiangah, "Note kong dong ding hi. Sabbath ni-in nahoih sep ding leh thusia bawl ding, nuntakna hotkhiat ding leh suksiat ding, koizaw phaltheih ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh a et kawikawi khit ciangin mipa' kiangah, "Na khut zankhia in," ci hi. Tua mipa in a khut zankhia a, a khut hoihkik hi.
Ahih hangin amaute lungso uh a, Jesu bangci suk theih ding cih thu khatlekhat kikum uh hi.
Ni khat, Jesu thungen dingin mualtung ah pai a, Pasian' kiangah thungetna zan tawntung zomsuak hi.
Khuavak ciangin a nungzuite sam a, tua teng lakpan sawmlenih tengkhia-in sawltakte ci-in minvawh hi.
Tua teng pen: Peter ci-in min a piak Simon, Simon' sanggampa Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
Matthew, Thomas, Alphaeus' tapa James, Gamkhualpac a kici Simon,
James' tapa Judas, leh lehhekpa a suak Judas Iscariot, ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute tawh tuaksuk a, mun zangna khat ah a nungzuite tampitak leh Judea gam bup, Jerusalem, leh tuipikil tunga Tyre leh Sidon pan mihonpite tawh ding uh hi.
Tuate pen ama' thugen a ngai ding leh natna satna pan damna ngah ding utin hong pai uh ahi hi. Kha nin tawh a buaite in zong damna ngah uh hi.
Mihonpi khempeuh in Jesu a lawnkhak ding uh hanciam uh hi. A hang pen ama' tungpan vangliatna pusuakin amaute a vekpi-un damsak ahih man hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite enin hih bangin gen hi: "No mizawngte thuphangah na hi uh hi; a hang pen Pasian' Kumpigam note' a ahi hi.
"No tu laitaka a gilkialte thupha ngah na hi uh hi; a hang pen na gil uh a vah ding hi. "No tu laitaka a kapte thuphangah na hi uh hi. A hang pen na nui ding uh hi.
"Mite in Mihing' Tapa hangin note hong muhdah ciangin leh hong puaseh, hong simmawhin migilo bangin na min uh hong nolh hong nial uh ciangin thuphangah na hi uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin lungdam unla gualnuamin diang un. A hang pen, en un, vantung ah na ngah ding uh pahtakman a lianpi ahi hi. A hang pen a pu a pate un tua bang mahin kamsangte tungah na bawl uh hi.
"Ahih hangin no mihaute a dahhuai na hi uh hi; a hang pen na ngahding uh hehnepna na ngah khinzo uh hi.
"Tu laitaka no a gilvahte a dahhuai na hi uh hi; a hang pen na gilkial ding uh hi. "Tu laitaka no a nuite a dahhuai na hi uh hi; a hang pen thumin tau-in na kap ding uh hi.
"Mi khempeuh in hong phat ciangin note a dahhuai na hi uh hi; a hang pen a pu a pate un zong kamsang zuaute tua dan mahin na bawl uh hi.
"Ahih hangin thu a ngaite' tungah kong cihin ah: Na galte uh it un. Hong mudahte' tungah nahoih sem un.
Hong samsiate thupha pia un. Hong bawlsiate thungetsak un.
Na paang hong beengte' kiangah a langkhat zong dawh in. Na puansilh hong laksakte na puantual sungsilh zong iit kei in.
Nang' kianga hong ngen khempeuh pia inla nang' kiangpan na neihsa hong laksakte ngenkik kei in.
No' tunga hong kibawl ding na deihdan nam uh midangte' tungah bawl un.
"No hong itte bek na it uhleh note' tungah a phattaak thu bang om ahi hiam? A hang pen mawhneite nangawn in amau a itte it lai buang uh hi.
No' tunga nahoih hong bawlte' tungah nahoih na bawl uhleh note' tungah a phattaak thu bang om ahi hiam? A hang pen mawhneite nangawn in tua danin bawl uh hi.
Ngahkik ding na lamette uh' tungah leitawi na piak uhleh note' tungah a phattaak thu bang om ahi hiam? Mawhneite nangawn in a piakzah uh ngahkik ding cihna tawh mawhneite' tungah leitawi pia uh hi.

Note na hih uhleh na galte uh it unla nahoih bawl un. Ngahkik ding bangmah lamen lo-in leitawi pia un. Tua hileh na ngah ding uh pahtakman a lianpi hiding a, note zong Sangpenpa' tate na hiding uh hi. A hang pen lungdamna a theilote leh migilote' tungah amah migi ahih man hi.
Na Pa uh thukhual ahih mah bangin note zong thukhual un.
"Thukhen kei un; tua hileh note' tungah thu hong kikhen lo ding hi. Mawhsiat kei un; tua hileh note hong kimawhsiat lo ding hi. Maisak un; tua hileh note hong kimaisak ding hi.
Pia un; tua hileh note hong kipia ding hi. Hoihtak-a kiteh, a kihenhen, a kitattat, a dimletin na ang uhah hong kipuak ding hi."
Jesu in thugenteh khat tawh zong hih bangin genbeh lai hi: "Khuamulo khat in khuamulo khat lamlak thei ding ahi hiam? A nihun dum sungah kia ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Nungzui thusin khat a syapa sangin lianzaw lo a, ahi zongin hoihtaka kipantah khempeuh a syapa tawh kibang ding uh hi.
Bang hangin na mit sunga singluang phawkkha lo pi-in na sanggampa' mit sunga ninthem mu na hi hiam?

Na mit sunga om singluang mu lo pi-in bangci bangin na sanggampa' kiangah, 'Sanggam aw, na mit sunga ninthem kong lakkhiatsak ding,' ci thei na hi hiam? Puatham kineih mi aw, nangma' mit sunga singluang lakhia masa in. Tua hileh na sanggampa' mit sunga ninthem teltak mu-in na lakkhiatsak thei ding hi.
"A hang pen singkung gina khat in gah limcilo gah lo a, tua mah bangin singkung ginalo khat in gah limci gah lo hi.
A hang pen singkung khempeuh a gah tungtawnin kithei hi. Lingnei kung panin theigah kilo lo a, ling sawlbawk panin lenggah kilo lo hi.
Mihoih in vanhoih a kholna a lungsim sungpan thuhoih suahkhia a, misia in vansia a kholna a lungsim sungpan thusia suahkhia hi. A hang pen lungsim sunga a dimlet teng kam tawh kipaukhia ahi hi.
"Bang hangin kong thupiakte sem lo pi-in 'Topa, Topa,' hong ci na hi uh hiam?
Ka kiangah hong pai-in ka thugente za-in a zui mi khempeuh kua tawh kibang cih kong lak ding hi:
Amah pen suangpi tunga inn a lam, khuamkua thuktak to-in khuambul a phut mipa tawh kibang hi. Tua inn limtak kilam ahih manin tui hong khangin guntui in a nawk hangin tua inn lok zolo hi.

Ahih hangin za napi-a a zui lote ahihleh khuambul phut lo pi-in leitham tungah inn a lam mipa tawh kibang hi. Guntui in tua inn a nawk ciangin thakhatin puk pah a, tua kisiatna lian mahmah hi."Za-uk Bupa' Silapa
